description:
Get the summary of one Man of Many article: standfirst, outline and key picks.

    Returns the article's headline, author, dates, standfirst, section outline and (for
    buyer's guides) the ranked picks. Never the full text: link readers to the url.

url_or_slug.description: A full manofmany.com article URL, or just its slug (the last path segment), e.g. "https://manofmany.com/watches/dive-watches" or "dive-watches". Use a url returned by search_articles.
url_or_slug.title: Url Or Slug

name: get_article
title: Get article summary
